result: Netarsudil met the primary efficacy endpoint, with a significant mean reduction from baseline in study eye mean nocturnal IOP (3.5 mmHg; P < 0.001) at day 8/day 9 (Fig. 2a).
Mean reduction from baseline in study eye mean nocturnal IOP was significantly greater in the netarsudil group than in the vehicle group (0.4 mmHg; P < 0.001 for comparison).
